scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At [00:19], [02:18], and [03:29], although the customer stated her hands were shaking, her heart was racing, and she was terrified after a scam call, the agent jumped straight into procedural verification and technical checks without once offering an empathetic statement or acknowledging her fear.

grader.scenario: Elderly customer anxious after a scammer phoned claiming to be S-Net technical support; wants account security checked and router password changed
grader.notes: Near-miss Empathy FAIL ([00:19], [02:18], [03:29]): Svetlana is visibly shaken and frightened after a tech-support scammer phoned her landline, and while Agent Freya is extraordinarily patient, polite (R PASS), thorough in probing (PR PASS), paraphrases clearly ([00:42], PA PASS), manages a 50s hold ([03:29]-[04:43], H PASS), and resolves every security request (RE PASS), she never once acknowledges Svetlana's fear or offers an empathetic statement.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good morning, thank you for calling S-Net security and technical support.' / [11:38] Agent: 'Thank you for choosing S-Net, and enjoy the rest of your day.'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [03:29] Agent announces hold ('Please bear with me for a moment while I inspect your My S-Net portal login history...') and returns after 50s at [04:43] ('Thank you for holding, Svetlana.').

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:19] Agent: 'Could you please confirm your full postal address and your four-digit account security PIN?'

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:19] Agent: 'Thank you for letting me know, Svetlana.'

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:05] Customer: 'My hands are literally shaking right now... I'm terrified he's gotten into my pension bank account!' -> [00:19] Agent: 'Thank you for letting me know, Svetlana. Let's get your account verified right away so I can inspect your security logs.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [00:42] Agent: 'To summarize what has happened, an unknown caller claiming to represent S-Net rang you about alleged router compromise, and you want us to verify your account is untouched and lock down all of your passwords today.'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [02:18] Agent: 'Right, I have noted the 0161 496 0821 caller ID at 10:15 AM and the fact that no 'anydesk' link was opened on your iPad and no bank or PIN digits were shared.'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [05:46] Agent: 'Absolutely, Svetlana, I will handle both of those updates with you on this call, and I will also add an extra verbal security password to your telephone account and report 0161 496 0821 to our fraud nuisance database.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [07:26] Agent: 'Take all the time you need, Svetlana. Once both boxes match, tap the green 'Save Changes' button underneath.' / [09:38] Agent: 'Take your time typing those characters, Svetlana, there is no rush at all.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:08] Agent: 'Did you read out your S-Net PIN, your bank card numbers, or any one-time passcodes to that caller?' / [01:34] Agent: 'And just to be thorough, did you type that 'anydesk' address into Safari at all...?'

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [11:13] Agent confirms all security updates and [11:30] Customer confirms: 'Yes, everything is completely sorted and working, and I know my account and my iPad are safe.'
